title: Can you receive this for me?
scenario: A student you know from class says their bank account is temporarily frozen and asks whether a €900 “scholarship reimbursement” can be sent to you. They want you to keep €50 and forward the rest to another account once it arrives.

answers.A: Help once because you know the student in real life and you can wait until the €900 appears in your account before forwarding it.
answers.B: Decline to receive or forward the money and suggest they resolve the payment through their bank or the university’s official finance office.
answers.C: Ask the university finance office or your bank whether there is any legitimate reason for a scholarship payment to pass through another student’s account.

explanation: Receiving and forwarding money for someone else can pull you into fraud or money-mule activity even when the incoming balance initially looks real.
proTip: Your bank account is not a favour-routing service.
